components.label: Returning User
components.note: A user with an existing session cookie.

components.label: Load Balancer
components.note: Terminates inbound HTTPS, routes each request by platform, skips unhealthy instances and keeps returning users on the same server.

components.label: Session Store
components.note: Tracks which instance owns each session so the load balancer can pin a returning user back to it.

components.label: Zone B
components.note: Availability Zone B: gives cross-zone capacity if Zone A degrades.

components.label: Instance A1
components.note: The instance this user is pinned to, in Zone A.

cards.title: User stickiness
items: A returning user's requests are pinned to the same instance to keep session state.

cards.title: Cross-zone balancing
items: Requests can also be spread across Zone A and Zone B for resilience.
